en: Hello, forest! Welcome to the festival!
how: big and bright, a host stepping onto the main stage, smiling, a little out of breath from landing
where: beat 16 (7.68 s), just after her wings land on the stage; the forest cheers back at beat 24

how: warm, teasing, rising on the question
where: beat 32 (15.36 s), as the kick comes in for the warm-up

how: short punchy shout
where: beat 40 (19.2 s); the whole forest starts clapping on the next bar

how: shouted, laughing, full energy
where: beat 64 (30.72 s), on the first drop into the dance floor; echo on 'djammið'

how: big, heavy and funny, like announcing a giant
where: beat 128 (61.44 s), as the grazers' stomp drops

how: slow and drawn out, sleepy-funny, a smile in it
where: beat 144 (69.12 s), the turtles' half-time bars

how: sudden, surprised, laughing
where: beat 152 (72.96 s), as the beat snaps to double time

how: shouted, laughing
where: beat 160 (76.8 s), as the frogs' part drops

how: fast and bouncy
where: beat 176 (84.48 s), as the lizards' chirp flurries start

en: And high up... the little flyers!
how: looking up, the voice lifting
where: beat 192 (92.16 s), as the flyers' whistles come in

en: The beetles and the dragonflies too!
how: delighted, a surprise guest act
where: beat 208 (99.84 s), as the beetles' click drums and the dragonflies' buzz come in

how: the headliner: a held breath, then big and proud
where: beat 220 (105.6 s), just before her horn's breakdown at beat 224

en: Wings up! And your hands, Egill!
how: excited, building
where: beat 256 (122.88 s), as the long build starts

how: a big festival call to the crowd
where: beat 264 (126.72 s) in the build, and again at beat 336 (161.28 s); the forest roars back each time

how: countdown, clear, one word, getting bigger each number
where: beat 278 (133.44 s); the grazers answer on G

how: countdown, a little bigger
where: beat 280 (134.4 s); the turtles answer on A

how: countdown, bigger
where: beat 282 (135.36 s); the frogs answer on B

how: countdown, bigger
where: beat 284 (136.32 s); the lizards answer on D

how: countdown, biggest
where: beat 286 (137.28 s); the flyers answer on E

how: the biggest shout of the night, joyful, not harsh
where: beat 288 (138.24 s), on the biggest drop

how: laughing in the wind, wild and free
where: beat 292 (140.16 s), at the top of the biggest drop

how: a big warm call, the festival anthem moment
where: beat 302 (144.96 s), into the anthem at beat 304, and again at beat 344 (165.12 s)

how: shouted, joyful, the last big moment
where: beat 350 (168 s), into the last chorus at beat 352

text: Takk fyrir djammið! Góða nótt, skógur!
en: Thanks for the party! Good night, forest!
how: warm and happy, a little softer, smiling
where: beat 389 (186.72 s), over the last held chord, before the last hit at beat 396
